messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed tenant invoice deltas (~5% under expected) for a handful of EU tenants after yesterday's routing rollout. Console preview shows token counts lower than raw events.
aj: Ugh. Any sign of late arrivals or dedupe kicking in?
maria: Not classic late arrivals. Digging through aggregator logs — looks like some stream shards got reassigned mid-aggregation window and the shard for partition 12 dropped ~30s.
ingest-bot: alert: consumer_group=token-aggregator, partition=12, rebalance=started, mismatch_count=213
kevin: Rebalance during a compact-agg window would explain partial aggregates. We have a 60s finalizer window; if shard moved, partial state might not have completed.
nora: Can we confirm which tenants were on partition 12? We should produce a sample set and run a replay locally to validate invoice impact.
maria: Yep — list of tenant_ids pulled, attaching quick query below.

default> SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) as events, SUM(token_est) as tokens FROM raw_events WHERE partition=12 AND ts >= '2026-03-18T10:00:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 20;

(devon uploaded)
devon: Quick repro steps I ran: spun up a local consumer with same group.id, forced partition assignment, then killed the broker to simulate rebalance. Observed ~40-60s of missing finalizer flush.
kevin: That matches. Two actionable items: 1) Make finalizer idempotent across reassigns (flush on new assignment), 2) Make console invoice preview flag suspicious tenant samples when a rebalance overlap occurs.
nora: For the console UX — show an orange warning on invoice preview: "counts may be incomplete due to recent routing/assignment changes" with link to action items.
sre-bot: note: rolling back the routing change for eu-edge was performed at 2026-03-18T11:15Z by infra-rollout-bot :white_check_mark:
maria: Rollback prevented further damage but we need reconciliation for the impacted hour. Proposing a targeted backfill for those tenant_ids using the raw_events window.
aj: For backfill we should also tag reconciled events with attribution: "reconciled_via: shard-backfill-20260318" so billing pipeline knows this was a post-hoc correction.
devon: Agreed. Also adding a small consumer-side metric: `agg_assignment_overlap_seconds` and emit per-tenant sample IDs to telemetry so we can detect recurring hit patterns.
kevin: Small config snippet suggestion to reduce window overlap risk: set `finalizer.max_hold_ms=30000` and `rebalance.grace_ms=5000` — experiment in canary before global.
maria: I'll open a runbook PR with checklist: identify tenants, run backfill job, apply reconciliation tag, update invoice preview UX, and schedule canary with those config changes. Assigning owners: devon (backfill job), nora (console UX), aj (finalizer fix), kevin (canary rollout). ETA EOD Friday?
nora: EOD Friday works for UX mock.
devon: I can start the backfill tonight, will post progress in this thread.
aj: I'll sketch the idempotent finalizer change and a small integration test to simulate reassigns.
maria: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone sees unexplained invoice deltas, ping me and include `partition=` in logs. :memo:
ingest-bot: info: backlog_replay_started job=shard-backfill-20260318 started_by=devon
thread_text_snippet: tenant invoice deltas after routing rollout, shard reassignment caused partial aggregates, plan: backfill + finalizer idempotency + console warning
